caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a historical women's dress displayed without a head or visible limbs. The outer layer of the dress is a pink fabric with a subtle floral pattern, and it features wide, flowing skirts that extend to the floor. The sleeves are three-quarter length, ending in ruffled white lace cuffs. The bodice is fitted with a gold triangular panel at the front, decorated with a black lacing or ribbon design. The neckline is square and trimmed with a white lace ruffle. Underneath the pink outer layer, there is an inner brownish-gold skirt with an ornate pattern. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Dress
